## Rolling mean of attendances

Say we wanted a 6 month rolling mean of attendances by each of the sites in
our data...

```{r}
# zoo has a lovely function for rolling windows
library(zoo)
library(NHSRdatasets)

data <- NHSRdatasets::ae_attendances

data |>
  dplyr::filter(org_code %in% c("RQM", "RJ1", "RDD")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    org_code,
    type,
    period
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rolling = zoo::rollapply(
      data = attendances,
      width = 6,
      FUN = mean,
      align = "right",
      fill = NA
    ),
    .by = c(org_code, type)
  )
```

## Over to you

- Replace any blanks with 9999

## Answer - altering the zoo rolling function

```{r}
data |>
  dplyr::filter(org_code %in% c("RQM", "RJ1", "RDD")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(org_code, type, period) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rolling = zoo::rollapply(
      data = attendances,
      width = 3,
      FUN = median,
      align = "center",
      fill = 9999
    ),
    .by = c(org_code, type)
  )
```
